verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's docs say the agent "reads your codebase" as part of its terminal workflow. That is the product's own capability, but it is only a passing mention, with nothing showing it explains architecture or points a developer to where changes should start. missing for 10: documented codebase-explanation or architecture-mapping features, guidance on locating entry points for changes, depth of how codebase reading is surfaced to the user, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes

citations.quote: ByteAsk opens a full-screen TUI, reads your codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests
